newsitem.title: UK: UK shares open higher, cautious ahead of expiry.
newsitem.headline: UK shares open higher, cautious ahead of expiry.

text.p: Leading British shares pushed ahead to record levels at Friday's opening, as the market faced a volatile sesison ahead of the expiry of September FTSE future and options, traders said.
Shortly after the open, the FTSE 100 jumped to a new best of 3,994.1, a rise of 19.8, beating its previous best of 3,987.7 set September 19.
UK shares are expected to see some wild swings with a move through the 4,000 level a distinct possibility, traders said.
"If the market starts to squeeze up we'll see the same as yesterday," said one trader.
